blocks.text: The verb написать is called perfective and expresses a single action with emphasis on its completion (either in the past or in the future, since the present tense deals only with actions in progress): *Я написал письмо; вот оно на столе.* *Ему я написал по-английски.*

Often the use of the proper aspect is clearly indicated by the context. For instance, the following words and phrases require the use of an imperfective verb: I. indicating duration of an action: долго, недолго, всё утро, весь день, etc. II. indicating habitual action: обычно, всегда, иногда, часто, редко, каждый день, каждую неделю, etc.

items: I have spoken with the Polish ambassador.
I've known her a long time.
I have seen him many times.
Он жил в Кобе три года.
He has lived in Kobe for three years.
Я никогда не делал тайны из своей гомосексуальности.
I've never made a secret of my homosexuality.
The Muses have always loved Sagittarius.
Tom has gone out for a walk.
